queries.title: Workflow observed job window — mean
queries.description: Mean of the exported histogram snapshot, by coverage quality. Observed first-to-last job window, not workflow wall-clock, queue time, critical path or a three-run benchmark.

queries.title: Job duration — mean by catalog job
queries.description: Available job duration histogram mean. ci_job is a trusted finite catalog; other contains unmapped jobs. Top 20 only; no per-run labels.
queries.query: topk(20, sum by (ci_job, quality) (toolkit_ci_job_duration_seconds_sum{workflow="ci",environment="test"}) / sum by (ci_job, quality) (toolkit_ci_job_duration_seconds_count{workflow="ci",environment="test"}))

queries.title: Module duration — mean by catalog module
queries.description: Complete module command duration only. Missing modules do not become zero; consult collection quality. Module spans are unavailable in evidence v1.
queries.query: topk(20, sum by (module, quality) (toolkit_ci_module_duration_seconds_sum{workflow="ci",environment="test"}) / sum by (module, quality) (toolkit_ci_module_duration_seconds_count{workflow="ci",environment="test"}))

queries.title: Step duration — mean by catalog job
queries.description: Available steps grouped by ci_job, never by arbitrary step or test name. One catch-all histogram bucket means quantiles cannot be computed.
queries.query: topk(20, sum by (ci_job, quality) (toolkit_ci_step_duration_seconds_sum{workflow="ci",environment="test"}) / sum by (ci_job, quality) (toolkit_ci_step_duration_seconds_count{workflow="ci",environment="test"}))

queries.title: Observed work — latest manifest gauge
queries.description: Job work and complete module work are separate gauges, not elapsed time. Partial coverage is retained. Do not sum the two scopes or integrate scrape samples into work totals.

queries.title: Outcomes — manifest snapshot, not run totals
queries.description: Observation-count gauges by scope and result. Different label sets can retain earlier manifests until expiry. This is not a run failure rate or lifetime counter; use trace tables for specific runs.

queries.title: Collection quality — retained snapshot
queries.description: Evidence, artifact, job, step and module quality remain distinct. Missing, invalid, partial and unavailable are not success. Empty results mean no telemetry, not zero missing evidence.

queries.title: Collector → Tempo failed span attempts
queries.description: Collector 0.162.0 send-failed counter since process start; retries can count a span repeatedly, not unique lost spans. Counter is lazy: zero is shown only after observed successful exports while self-scrape is up. No telemetry before first delivery or while scrape is down. This excludes pre-Collector Toolkit HTTP failures.
queries.query: (sum by (exporter) (otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans_total{job="collector-internal",exporter="otlp_grpc/tempo"}) or (0 * sum by (exporter) (otelcol_exporter_sent_spans_total{job="collector-internal",exporter="otlp_grpc/tempo"}))) and on() (up{job="collector-internal",instance="collector:8888"} == 1)

queries.title: Collector Prometheus exporter failed point attempts
queries.description: Exporter-reported failed metric-point attempts since restart. Zero requires a successful export and live self-scrape. The pull exporter accepting points into its cache is not proof Prometheus scraped or retained them; inspect source-series/query smoke too. Not Toolkit HTTP delivery status.
queries.query: (sum by (exporter) (otelcol_exporter_send_failed_metric_points_total{job="collector-internal",exporter="prometheus"}) or (0 * sum by (exporter) (otelcol_exporter_sent_metric_points_total{job="collector-internal",exporter="prometheus"}))) and on() (up{job="collector-internal",instance="collector:8888"} == 1)

queries.title: Tempo export queue pressure — lag proxy
queries.description: 100 × waiting batches / configured capacity (256). Backlog pressure is a lag proxy, not elapsed seconds. In-flight requests have left the queue and can retry while this reads zero; inspect the adjacent in-flight panel. The Prometheus pull exporter has no equivalent sending queue.
queries.query: (100 * sum by (exporter) (otelcol_exporter_queue_size{job="collector-internal",exporter="otlp_grpc/tempo"}) / sum by (exporter) (otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity{job="collector-internal",exporter="otlp_grpc/tempo"})) and on() (up{job="collector-internal",instance="collector:8888"} == 1)

queries.title: Tempo export requests in flight / retry backoff
queries.description: Active requests including retry backoff. Sustained activity plus failed attempts signals a blocked backend even if queue utilization is zero. This is requests, not spans or elapsed lag seconds. Metric is development stability in the pinned Collector; revalidate names on upgrade.

queries.title: Collector self-scrape health — 1 up / 0 down
queries.description: Prometheus scrape health for collector:8888 on the Compose network. Zero means the operational panels cannot observe current exporter state. It does not describe the CI conclusion or prove backend delivery. No host port exposes the internal endpoint.

queries.title: Successful workflow traces — up to 20 matches
queries.description: Select a trace ID to open Tempo. Run ID links open original Actions and its manifest artifact list; match the selected manifest digest before downloading. Fixed repository and digit-only run IDs prevent arbitrary URL interpolation.
queries.query: { resource.service.name = "onmaru-ci" && span.toolkit.ci.scope = "workflow" && span.cicd.pipeline.name = "ci" && span.vcs.repository.name = "YRootLab/OnMaru-backend" && span.cicd.pipeline.run.id =~ "[1-9][0-9]{0,18}" && span.cicd.pipeline.result = "success" } | select(span.cicd.pipeline.run.id, span.toolkit.ci.run.attempt, span.toolkit.ci.manifest.digest, span.cicd.pipeline.result)

queries.title: Non-success workflow traces — up to 20 matches
queries.description: Includes failure, timeout, cancellation, skipped and unknown outcomes. ERROR status alone would miss cancellation. Untimed workflows have no synthetic workflow span; consult local evidence when traces are absent.
queries.query: { resource.service.name = "onmaru-ci" && span.toolkit.ci.scope = "workflow" && span.cicd.pipeline.name = "ci" && span.vcs.repository.name = "YRootLab/OnMaru-backend" && span.cicd.pipeline.run.id =~ "[1-9][0-9]{0,18}" && span.cicd.pipeline.result != "success" } | select(span.cicd.pipeline.run.id, span.toolkit.ci.run.attempt, span.toolkit.ci.manifest.digest, span.cicd.pipeline.result)
